ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories against the UN consolidated sanctions list, OFAC/SDN list, UK (HMT) sanctions, EU restrictive measures, and Vanuatu FIU watchlists. PEP status must be assessed through commercial due diligence databases; enhanced due diligence applies to any PEP, with source-of-funds verification and senior management approval. Negative media and adverse financial crime screening must be documented and retained under the AML/CFT Act and VFSC Rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry — International Company Name Reservation via licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be submitted in English, French, or any language using the Latin alphabet; non-Latin script names require an approved Latin-script transliteration. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not mislead as to the company's activities or imply government, professional, or regulated status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent may, within 14 calendar days, submit to VFSC a written appeal containing the requested name, grounds of legal justification, comparison with the conflicting name, and the prescribed reconsideration fee. VFSC Registry must respond within 5 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may re-file under a revised name or seek judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office at a licensed registered agent's office in Port Vila. Physical office presence of the company is not required for trading activities, and operational functions may be conducted remotely.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 4%–10% annual probability of unannounced inspection or spot-check for commodity and battery-metals traders classified as Medium-Risk Enhanced; VFSC and FIU may carry out on-site visits without prior notice to the registered agent or principal.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) as amended: ss. 7-12 (registration and certificate of incorporation), ss. 14-20 (constitution and memorandum/articles of association), ss. 21-27 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 31-40 (directors, secretary and officers), and s. 54 (tax exemption for international companies).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Section / Registrar of International Companies, Bougainville Street, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company (VFSC Form IC-1) submitted via the VFSC e-Registry, accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement under the International Companies Act; the Articles may authorise US$50,000 share capital or no-par shares; issued paid-up share capital may be set at one share for a nominal US$1 consideration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription and allotment of the Company's initial shares be and is hereby approved on the terms set out in the Memorandum, each subscriber paying the agreed consideration in full, and that no escrow deposit of paid-up capital is required under the International Companies Act Cap. 222. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be and is hereby established at the registered agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the licensed registered agent be and is hereby appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the named persons be appointed as sole director and company secretary of the Company, each with authority to execute instruments, open bank accounts, and conduct the cross-border procurement business of battery-grade lithium carbonate powder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry (online e-Registry portal or Bougainville Street counter, Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a VFSC name reservation request listing one primary and two alternative company names. VFSC checks the proposed names against the registered names index and restricted expressions (e.g. bank, trust, insurance). Upon clearance, the name is reserved for 30 calendar days pending filing of the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: VFSC name reservation request letter
Passport copy of applicant/incorporator
Brief statement of intended business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as unavailable or misleading, resubmit with revised names or appeal in writing to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days; the reservation clock restarts upon a cleared resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / corporate services provider (approved under the International Companies Act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English; incorporate the company name, registered office clause located at the registered agent's Port Vila address, registered agent clause, share capital provisions, director and indemnity clauses, and permitted-object purposes. Execute the subscriber pages before a witness or notary and initial every page for identity of version.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate/reference
Signed subscriber execution pages
Director and company secretary consent forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the constitutional documents, prepare and execute an amendment or restatement curing the queried clause and re-lodge within 14 days; the first corrective filing is not subject to a new government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of incorporation application and fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Section (Registrar of International Companies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File VFSC Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, director and secretary consents, and registered agent consent. Pay the US$750 state incorporation fee by wire or card into the VFSC confirmed account. The Registrar checks compliance with the Act before issuing the certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed VFSC Form IC-1
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Signed consent to act as director (each director)
Signed consent of registered agent and registered office
Payment confirmation of US$750 VFSC fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent has 14 days to supply the additional particulars; on expiry without response the application is deemed withdrawn, and a fresh application with corrected documents may be re-filed without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar certifies the company number, name, date of incorporation and authorised capital. The Certificate of Incorporation is conclusive evidence that the company is incorporated under Cap. 222. Order certified copies for bank, counsel and counterparty onboarding.
required_dossiers: No applicant filing required; collect original and certified copies from VFSC e-Registry or courier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is lost, damaged or contains a typographical error, apply through the registered agent for a replacement or correction within 10 working days at the VFSC nominal replacement fee (approximately US$50).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation first board resolution and officer installation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company, assisted by the company secretary and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution: approval of share subscription and allotment, adoption of the registered office and registered agent, appointment of first director(s) and company secretary, and authorisation to open bank accounts and execute cross-border procurement contracts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Notice of first board meeting or written resolution form
Consent and appointment forms for director and secretary
Statutory registers (register of members, register of directors)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum cannot be achieved, the resolution may be validly passed as a unanimous written resolution signed by all directors entitled to vote, provided the Articles do not abrogate written resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of continued-compliance details and annual VFSC obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Section and the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office and registered agent particulars in the statutory records and fix the financial year end. The International Company is exempt from domestic income tax and business licensing while no local business is carried on; however, the VFSC annual government fee (approximately US$500) must be paid each year to maintain good standing and to remain entitled to the statutory tax exemption.
required_dossiers: Registered agent services agreement
VFSC annual fee invoice and payment record
Company calendar/reconciliation of filing deadlines
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual fee is paid late, VFSC issues a late-filing penalty and possible strike-off; cure is effected by settling the arrears plus penalty and, if struck off, applying for restoration within 30 days of notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable: the International Company is an offshore non-resident vehicle under Cap. 222 and is excluded from the Vanuatu domestic Business Licence regime; no VIPA foreign-investment licence is required because no local Vanuatu business is carried on.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operational or manufacturing permit is required for a pure cross-border procurement and resale arbitrage activity in battery-grade lithium carbonate powder; no industrial installation or premises permit applies.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Environment and Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt: the IC conducts no development, construction or industrial processing in Vanuatu. If a broker/warehouse office were established, the activity would fall under DEPC Category B (Registration only), not a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, process discharge or VOC emissions arise from trading activities. Any storage of sealed lithium carbonate powder is subject to DEPC solid-waste management rules and Port Vila municipal waste collection standards, with powder spills treated as inert recovered waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for offshore trading. If physical offices are opened, the occupier must obtain a fire-safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service (fire extinguishers, means of escape) and an occupational health and safety registration with the Vanuatu Department of Labour for the Port Vila premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (Department of Customs and Inland Revenue), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal: https://customs-inlandrevenue.gov.vu; customs clearance through ASYCUDA World; company registration through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] via a VFSC-licensed registered agent; obtain the VFSC company number, Certificate of Incorporation, and registered office. Step 2: Because Vanuatu levies no income tax, no income TIN exists; the IC is automatically tax-exempt on offshore business and files no tax returns. Step 3: If the IC makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding the threshold, or elects voluntary registration to reclaim input VAT on export purchases, file the VAT registration application with Vanuatu Revenue and Customs together with incorporation documents, registered agent confirmation, and turnover projections; the Commissioner issues a VAT registration certificate bearing a unique VAT registration number. Step 4: For physical movements, enrol in ASYCUDA World for electronic export/import declarations; thereafter maintain VFSC annual license renewal and registered agent records.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Vanuatu law. The IC is statutorily non-resident and exempt from income tax, VAT, stamp duty, and exchange control on offshore business. The only available election is a Ministerial permit to carry on business in Vanuatu or with Vanuatu residents, which confines the automatic exemption to offshore activity and subjects the permitted local activity to standard laws; otherwise, no entity classification elections apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 [Cap 241]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 of taxable turnover in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted for exporters to recover input VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate is currently in force. Registered businesses must issue sequential tax invoices (paper or electronic) containing prescribed particulars; all customs transactions are processed electronically through ASYCUDA World with digital submission of the Single Administrative Document.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated where supplied to a non-resident buyer, the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply, and the export is evidenced by customs declarations and transport documents. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident for use wholly outside Vanuatu, including international freight. For the offshore battery-metals arbitrage model, a non-resident IC conducting procurement and re-invoicing entirely outside Vanuatu makes no Vanuatu taxable supply and remains outside the scope of VAT with an effective 0% rate; if goods are routed through Vanuatu, the exporter must substantiate zero-rating with full customs and banking records. Excess input VAT credits arising from zero-rated export supplies are refundable upon submission of the VAT return and supporting export evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document filed via ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing departure from Vanuatu customs territory
Commercial Invoice issued by the VAT-registered exporter
Packing List and Certificate of Weight/Quality for battery-grade lithium carbonate
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing foreign currency settlement
Original supply/purchase contract for the cross-border lithium carbonate transaction
Certificate of Origin (only where required by the destination state)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no exchange control or statutory FX repatriation deadline; 180 days is applied as the maximum evidentiary window for matching inward remittance certificates to zero-rated export invoices. Zero-rating refund claims are scrutinised against ASYCUDA World export declarations, bank statements, and remittance certificates. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract retrospective reassessment (3 years standard; extended where misrepresentation or fraud is established), clawback of refunded input VAT with interest, monetary fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years for knowingly false statements under the VAT Act; false customs export declarations attract forfeiture of goods and penalties of up to 3 times the duty value under the Customs Act [Cap 145]; directors and officers are further exposed to VFSC licence revocation and anti-money-laundering proceedings under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, with penalties including substantial fines and imprisonment up to 20 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the monetary authority and exchange-control administrator under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 63]. Policy oversight vests in the Minister of Finance, while day-to-day regulatory and licensing coordination for offshore vehicles is performed by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). All licensed commercial banks in Vanuatu operate as authorized dealers under RBV supervision.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is convertible for all current account transactions, consistent with long-standing IMF Article VIII obligations. For an International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], the capital account is effectively unrestricted: ICs are statutorily exempt from the Exchange Control Act, so equity injections, intercompany loan disbursements, and profit/principal remittances require no prior RBV authorization. The practical constraint is market depth, not law: VUV is thinly traded offshore, and settlement for a lithium-carbonate procurement house is therefore denominated in USD, AUD, or CNH. The IC should maintain zero residual VUV exposure and a documented policy that all borrowings, invoices, and liquidity buffers are held in settlement currencies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation applies. There is no statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation deadline for export or trading receivables booked by an IC. Foreign-denominated proceeds may be retained indefinitely in the IC's licensed bank accounts in any currency. The only compliance duties are customer due diligence verification of the underlying trade contract (invoice, bill of lading, packing list) and retention of transaction records for a minimum of five years under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account (multi-currency USD/AUD/VUV), with documentary credit line
Operational Account (USD/AUD/VUV) and Trade Finance Account with SWIFT direct-clearing capability
Operational Account and FX Account (USD/EUR/VUV), with working-capital facilities
Escrow Account and Private Banking Operational Account (USD/AUD)
Operational Account (VUV only); not suitable for offshore IC clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Vanuatu has no e-money institution (EMI) licensing regime, and the VFSC does not license standalone payment-service aggregators for ICs. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., UK FCA-authorised or Lithuanian EMIs) may be tolerated only for ancillary operational disbursements below USD 10,000 per transaction and are rejected as clearing conduits for high-value battery-grade lithium carbonate trade settlements. Tier-1 banks and their correspondents classify unlicensed aggregators as medium-high risk; any EMI usage must be pre-disclosed to the Relationship Manager, earmarked in the liquidity policy as non-core, and backed by a full audit trail to the underlying commercial contract.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily mandated. Remote onboarding is accepted in practice where the IC is introduced by a VFSC-licensed registered agent and provides notarized passports, certified board resolutions, certificate of incumbency, and source-of-funds evidence. However, ANZ and BSP reserve the right to require an in-person interview at the Port Vila branch for at least one signatory when Enhanced Due Diligence applies, which is automatic where annual turnover exceeds USD 1 million or where supply-chain counterparties include high-risk jurisdictions. Video KYC is accepted for non-signatory directors and additional authorized signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low-substance offshore shell profile: 100% foreign ownership, nominee directors, no employees, no physical premises, and no local economic presence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing; VFSC license of the registered agent; certificate of incumbency naming all directors and shareholders; executed commercial lease or licensed management-office agreement in Vanuatu; resume and contract of a named local compliance officer or process agent; substance and business-plan affidavit describing the lithium-carbonate procurement operation; audited or CPA-compiled opening balance sheet and projected cash flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and dual-use exposure: counterparties, transshipment hubs, or ultimate beneficiaries touching China, Russia, Hong Kong, or Dubai in the battery-metals supply chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated and manual sanctions screening printout (OFAC SDN, EU, UN, HMRC, AU DFAT) covering all counterparties, banks, shipping agents, and UBOs; complete KYC pack and corporate chart of each supplier; Incoterms 2020 purchase contracts; country-of-origin certificates; transport chain documents (bill of lading, air waybill, packing list, customs declarations); contractual exclusion clauses for Russia, Belarus, Iran, North Korea, and Syria; QA/QC certification from SGS or Bureau Veritas confirming battery-grade purity; MSDS and REACH compliance statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags: invoice valuations deviating from market benchmarks, split payments, rapid round-tripping, or mismatches between LC value, invoice value, and shipped quantity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent price benchmark report (Fastmarkets, S&P Global Commodity Insights, or Shanghai Metals Market lithium carbonate assessment) attached to each invoice; UBO declaration and group organizational chart; one-to-one audit package matching each MT103/MT700 to warehouse receipts and inspection certificates; single-deal pairing of payment amount, invoice amount, and shipping documents; six-month bank statements of the supplier where open-account terms are used; written treasury policy prohibiting cash payments, third-party payees, and invoice splitting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of wealth/funds for capital injections originating from Singapore, Hong Kong, or Australian entities with opaque ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tier-1 bank reference letters covering the previous six months; source-of-wealth statement with supporting contracts, dividend vouchers, or equity-sale agreements; audited financial statements or CPA-compiled financials of the funding entity; certified board resolution approving each injection and specifying the funding instrument (equity versus shareholder loan); escrow or confirmed LC structure replacing any upfront prepayment; pre-advice memo delivered to the bank seven days before the first debit.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All upstream funding is transmitted via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the shareholder's tier-1 bank (Hong Kong, Singapore, or Australia) into the IC's USD operational account at ANZ or BSP in Port Vila. The wire must carry an explicit purpose narrative: 'Direct investment equity contribution for battery-material procurement under loan/equity agreement dated [date]'; where the correspondent bank requires balance-of-payments classification, the narrative identifies the flow as BPM6 Direct Investment Equity Capital. The supporting bundle, delivered to the Relationship Manager before value date, comprises the certified board resolution, signed shareholder funding or loan agreement, UBO and source-of-funds declarations for every funder, and the IC's certificate of incumbency. Wires exceeding USD 1 million must be pre-advised 48 hours in advance. No RBV prior approval is required, but the receiving bank must report the flow in its Exchange Control Act statistical return; funds should first arrive in USD and be immediately converted or held rather than channeled through VUV to avoid conversion friction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements run on two rails. Rail one: SWIFT MT103 direct covers for supplier invoices below USD 500,000, including CNH-denominated payments cleared through CNH clearing banks in Hong Kong (e.g., via HSBC or Standard Chartered) with the ISIC 4662 business code and the supply contract reference stated in the narrative. Rail two: irrevocable documentary letters of credit governed by UCP 600 for cargo volumes of USD 500,000 or more, issued at sight or 90-day usance from the IC's operational account, and confirmed by a top-50 international bank outside Vanuatu to eliminate correspondent and country-bank risk. Payments to regional Asian banks outside the standard Vanuatu correspondent network are layered through a third-party correspondent (HSBC, Standard Chartered, or JPMorgan) to guarantee clearing finality. All outbound disbursements must match the contract, inspection certificate, and invoice on a one-to-one basis, with no third-party payees and no netting against unrelated receivables.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV outright forward contracts with RBV-licensed authorized dealers onshore, tenor up to 12 months and subject to board approval; market liquidity is thin and spreads are wide, so utilization is limited to residual VUV tax/nominal exposures only

USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore with top-tier New York or Hong Kong banks under an ISDA 2002 with Credit Support Annex; permitted solely to hedge confirmed CNH procurement payables
USD/AUD and USD/CNH cross-currency swaps matched to the underlying purchase and resale tenors, permitted for hedge-only purposes under a VFSC no-objection confirmation for the IC's trade book

Natural hedging via multi-currency operational accounts (USD, CNH, AUD, NZD) maintained at ANZ or BSP, with a board-approved no-speculation policy capping all derivative tenors and notionals to confirmed commercial exposures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return for International Company (IC Form AR-1) with certification of share capital, members, directors, and UBO register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the anniversary of incorporation; return due within 30 days after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC late-filing penalty of VUV 1,000 (approx. USD 8) per month or part of a month; late payment of annual government fee attracts a 10% penalty surcharge; failure to file or pay for more than 12 months after the anniversary date exposes the IC to administrative strike-off by the Registrar and dissolution after publication in the Official Gazette

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Declaration and Change-of-Registered-Office Notification (if any change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration executed with the Annual Return at each incorporation anniversary; changes to registered office or registered agent must be notified to the Registrar within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu constitutes a continuing statutory breach under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) and may trigger the Registrar's discretionary strike-off; late notification of change attracts administrative fines and impedes issuance of the annual Certificate of Good Standing

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: International Companies are statutorily audit-exempt for ordinary trading activities; mandatory independent audit applies only if the IC is licensed by VFSC for banking, insurance, securities dealing, or other regulated financial services, or if the VFSC exercises discretionary audit direction; domestic Companies Act thresholds (annual turnover exceeding VUV 50 million, approx. USD 420,000, or total assets exceeding VUV 25 million) do not apply to the exempt International Company
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Vanuatu; no statutory financial statement filing is required for International Companies; books may be maintained in any major currency with adequate records to explain transactions and financial position

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-licensed registered agent maintains a confidential register of ultimate beneficial owners; any share transfer requires immediate register update and a signed beneficial ownership declaration from the transferee; annual confirmation of shareholding and UBO details must accompany the Annual Return at each incorporation anniversary; any transfer or change of beneficial ownership must be communicated to the registered agent within 14 days, with the updated register certified and retained on site

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500–1,500 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office inclusive; typical market midpoint approx. USD 950)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (statutorily audit-exempt); voluntary independent review typically USD 3,000–6,500 if required by counterparties, banks, or due diligence processes

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax; International Companies are statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective statutory tax rate. The International Company (IC) enjoys complete tax exemption under the International Companies Act and Vanuatu's Income Tax Act does not levy a corporate profits tax. The only recurring state charge is the VFSC annual license/registration fee, not an income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for an International Company in Vanuatu. The mandatory recurring compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Return/Annual Registration Renewal submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual renewal must be completed on or before the anniversary date of registration (or such later date as the VFSC renewal notice specifies). Because Vanuatu levies no CIT, no fiscal-year-end income tax filing deadline is applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name as shown on the VFSC certificate; no Vanuatu tax identification number is required for a tax-exempt IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu and details of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may not use a letterbox office without a physical VFSC-agent presence; state the agent's address and license number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary, and shareholders, including residential addresses and identification details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: International directors and ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed to the VFSC beneficial ownership register, subject to confidentiality.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual exemption declaration and confirmation of no taxable business conducted in Vanuatu or with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that all sales of battery-grade lithium carbonate are concluded offshore and that no revenue is derived from Vanuatu-source activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance status declaration, including whether the IC is engaged in a Relevant Activity under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a cross-border lithium carbonate procurement and resale entity, declare if distribution or service-center activity is carried out, and, if so, provide the VFSC economic substance return details by the statutory deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment of the annual renewal fee triggers a VFSC late penalty of 10% of the prescribed annual fee plus a daily surcharge of VUV 2,500 for each month of default. Continued non-compliance for more than six months can result in administrative strike-off, deregistration of the IC, disqualification of the registered agent, and referral to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission enforcement unit for financial penalties up to VUV 1,000,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Vanuatu does not impose dividend withholding tax on distributions paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders, and no domestic withholding, exchange-control, or capital-gains charge applies to profit repatriation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-taxation agreement of practical relevance for IC profit repatriation. An IC is entitled to rely directly on the statutory exemption contained in the International Companies Act. If a foreign tax authority requires proof of Vanuatu tax-exempt status, the shareholder or IC may request a tax-exemption certificate from the VFSC; no TRC filing protocol exists because Vanuatu does not assess corporate income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax applies to royalties and debt interest paid by a Vanuatu International Company. There is no treaty rate to invoke; the same 0% rate applies to cross-border licensing of IP related to lithium carbonate procurement and to interest on shareholder or third-party debt.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory monetary threshold exists in VUV for Local File or Master File obligations because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no transfer-pricing filing regime. However, under the VFSC economic substance compliance framework, a Vanuatu IC engaged in a Relevant Activity such as distribution or service-center business with gross operating income above VUV 30,000,000 must maintain contemporaneous transactional records, margin analyses, and arm's length evidence in Vatu to demonstrate that its cross-border lithium carbonate purchases and resales are commercially substantive and properly priced.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu International Companies (Economic Substance) Act applies to an International Company carrying on a Relevant Activity. Cross-border procurement, distribution, and resale of battery-grade lithium carbonate constitutes distribution and service-center activity. The IC must demonstrate substance in Vanuatu through local management meetings, adequate physical offices, qualified employees engaged in procurement documentation, and core decision-making records held in Vanuatu. Failure to file the annual economic substance return may result in a VFSC fine of up to VUV 4,000,000, strike-off, and disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abusive Offshore Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC fictionally to hold lithium carbonate supply contracts while the actual management, sales negotiation, and risk-bearing activities occur in a foreign high-tax jurisdiction; mispricing intercompany sales; backdating purchase agreements; or failing to disclose the IC's beneficial owner to circumvent foreign tax declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Penal Code and VFSC enforcement powers, the IC may be subject to fines up to VUV 1,000,000, deregistration, asset restraint orders, and compulsory restitution of economic benefits. Cooperation with foreign tax authorities under a TIEA may trigger civil assessment and penalties abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly files a false annual declaration or signs sham trading documentation faces personal civil restitution, disqualification from acting as a director, a travel restriction, and imprisonment for up to five years under Vanuatu law.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a bare title-holder for lithium carbonate contracts with no physical office in Vanuatu, no resident management, no substance expenditure, no local employee, and no VFSC economic substance return despite carrying on a distribution Relevant Activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may impose a penalty of up to VUV 2,500,000, order immediate strike-off of the company, prohibit the registered agent from representing the IC, and refer the company to the Vanuatu director disqualification registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the company's economic-substance penalty if the failure is willful; additional personal sanctions include director disqualification for up to ten years, civil recovery orders, and travel bans while enforcement proceedings are active.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify and disclose the ultimate beneficial owner of the lithium carbonate trading IC; accepting SWIFT LC or wire-transfer payments from unverified third-party intermediaries; omitting customer due diligence records; or structuring transactions to obscure the origin of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016 imposes criminal fines up to VUV 100,000,000 on the IC and VUV 50,000,000 on senior officers; VFSC may suspend or revoke any license, freeze accounts, and confiscate the proceeds of suspicious wire transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who participate in or knowingly facilitate money-laundering arrangements are personally liable to imprisonment up to fifteen years, civil forfeiture of assets, travel bans, and disqualification from holding financial-sector offices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring distributions or paying management fees, royalties, or intercompany loan repayments to related parties while the IC is insolvent and cannot pay trade creditors for battery-grade lithium carbonate shipments; stripping assets to defeat creditor claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A court may set aside the fraudulent preference transaction under Vanuatu's insolvency and International Companies Act provisions, order restitution of the transferred value, and impose a fine on the company for unlawful distributions to shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid trade debts, ordered to reimburse corporate funds personally, subjected to asset forfeiture and travel restrictions, and imprisoned for up to seven years if fraudulent trading is established.
